commit_message:
Integrate Torch-MLIR to llvm/torch-mlir@1828c5053 (#24691)

Integrates Torch-MLIR via `iree-org/torch-mlir/sm-iree-integrates/torch-20260707` branch.

Includes a CMake fix for https://github.com/llvm/torch-mlir/commit/35010fc69.
Promotes ONNX ops test case `test_convtranspose_output_shape` to an expected pass.

On top of the integrated upstream commit, the 3 latest fixes from
`sm-iree-integrates/llvm-20260617` are carried over:

"Adaptions to llvm/llvm-project@75b7809248cc for integrating LLVM into
IREE" by @schuermans-roofline as commit ec8720b
"Adaptions to llvm/llvm-project@917117ceeebf for integrating LLVM into
IREE" by @schuermans-roofline as commit 67c8c41
"Bump LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@0f3ca6bb9ca5" by @lialan as commit
ba9dad2
